name: Hozumi
source:
Member of the Special Division 3 of the demon supervision unit. He devotes himself to killing demons and never thinks of adjusting to the pace of his comrades. He is the most problematic member in the division, but also the one who has killed more demons than anyone else. The people in the guard were also unable to handle him, so he was placed in Division 3. He does not take kindly to the fact that Mahora is living with a demon.

[Translated from [url=http://lovedelivery.biz/suito/chara.html]the official website[/url].]
